eps.ov: A college dropout in search of ramen crosses paths with a self-proclaimed deity of matrimony. This bizarre meeting sends the young man hurtling through a horrifying flashback to his days as a “black cupid.”
eps.oa: يلتقي طالب جامعي متسرب من الدراسة، وهو يبحث عن الرامن، بكائن يزعم أنه إله الزواج. فيلقي هذا اللقاء الغريب بالشاب في استعادة مرعبة لأيامه «كيوبيداً أسود».

eps.ov: The not-so-lovable loser and his sidekick Ozu use hidden cameras in an attempt to overthrow the head of the campus movie circle. Glorious revolution is the goal, but if their plan backfires - things could get ugly.
eps.oa: يستعمل الخاسر غير المحبوب ورفيقه «أوزو» كاميرات خفية في محاولة للإطاحة برئيس نادي السينما في الجامعة. والغاية ثورة مجيدة، لكن إن ارتدت الخطة عليهما فقد تسوء الأمور كثيراً.

eps.ov: After the campus cleanup crew confiscates his state-of-the-art bicycle, a college misfit trades his wheels for some wings in an attempt to become a human birdman. Why? To impress a girl, of course.
eps.oa: بعد أن يصادر فريق النظافة في الجامعة دراجته الحديثة، يستبدل طالب جامعي غريب الأطوار بعجلاته جناحين في محاولة ليصير رجلاً طائراً. لماذا؟ ليبهر فتاة طبعاً.

eps.ov: A lowly college student signs on as a disciple to a madman who’s wanted by the library police. His first assignment: accompany the girl of his dreams on a quest to attain a mystical toilet brush.
eps.oa: يصير طالب جامعي متواضع تلميذاً لمجنون تطارده «شرطة المكتبة». ومهمته الأولى: أن يرافق فتاة أحلامه في سعيها إلى الظفر بفرشاة مرحاض أسطورية.

eps.ov: The Softball Club, with its supply of tanned and toned female members, seems like a good place for a lonely boy to find intimacy, but the action takes a foul turn when his only friend hatches another heinous scheme.
eps.oa: تبدو جمعية الكرة اللينة، بعضواتها الرياضيات اللواتي لوّحتهن الشمس، مكاناً مناسباً لفتى وحيد يبحث عن الأُلفة. لكن الأمور تنحرف حين يدبر صديقه الوحيد مكيدة شنيعة أخرى.

eps.ov: When a young man seeks romance and adventure by joining the foreign language club, he gets caught in a bizarre love triangle where a night of drinking leads to intrusive gum massages and sloppy tongue baths.
eps.oa: حين يلتحق شاب بنادي اللغات الأجنبية طلباً للحب والمغامرة، يقع في مثلث حب غريب، تنتهي فيه ليلة شرب إلى مواقف محرجة لا تخطر على بال.

eps.ov: Everyone falls in love at least once during college, but not everyone severs all connections with actual humans in favor of an illicit romance with a life-sized plastic doll.
A name scrawled inside a secondhand novel leads to a romantic exchange of letters, but the storybook ending takes a bizarre turn when the two star-crossed pen pals meet face-to-face.

Membership has its privileges, but not for an unsuspecting college student forcibly initiated into the Secret Society Lucky Cat Chinese Restaurant! Will his covertly cruel conduct spoil a young man’s chance at love?

An unusual young man with no interest in the outside world tries to survive the college experience by refusing to leave his room. Will it be extreme hunger or a desire for female companionship that forces him out first?

eps.t: The End of the 4.5 Tatami Age
eps.ov: The angst-ridden narrator becomes lost in a maze of 4.5 Tatami rooms as he searches for what lingers just out of reach. Will he finally make the long-awaited, often-hinted-at love connection he’s sought for so long?
